text:
Here are guidelines for crafting a farewell message based on Nextbridge Ltd.'s context and industry standards:  

1. **Keep it concise**: Aim for 3–5 sincere sentences expressing gratitude, sharing a positive memory, and offering well wishes. For example:  
   > "Thank you for the opportunity to work with such a talented team! I’ll miss our collaboration and wish you all continued success. Feel free to reach out!" [document4, p.1]  

2. **Timing**: Send your message on or before your final day to allow colleagues time to respond before system access is revoked. A company-wide email sent on your last workday is ideal [document5, p.1].  

3. **Tone**: Maintain a warm, gracious, and optimistic tone. Avoid negativity or airing grievances. For close colleagues, add personal touches (e.g., inside jokes) but keep messages focused on professional relationships [document2, p.1].  

4. **Examples**:  
   - "It’s been a pleasure working with all of you. Thank you, and best of luck in the future!" [document4, p.1]  
   - "Memories of our time together will last forever. I’ll always cherish the support you’ve given me!" [document4, p.1]  

For personalized messages, reference specific projects or collaborations (e.g., "The *Betterhomes* project was a highlight—thank you for your expertise!"). Always include your contact details for future communication.  

If you need further assistance, reach out to Nextbridge’s team at **sales@nextbridge.com** [document3, p.1]. Safe travels! 🌟---
